title: Read one's mind
content: Meaning/Usage: When someone says something that you were also thinking about. Explanation: This is a stronger way of saying, "I was thinking of that too." "You read my mind." "I was going to suggest that. You must have read my mind." A: "Do you want to go play pool?" B: "You read my mind. That's exactly what I was thinking too."

examples.sentence: I was going to suggest that. You must have read my mind.
